answer_1.quote: In the task of Table to Text Generation , the output summaries usually are of two types: Descriptive and Analytical ...

answer_2.quote: We use several automatic metrics to measure the relative quality of the generated sentences compared to the reference: BLEU , ROUGE-L , semantic similarity with sentence embeddings using the MPNet model ; (ii) Between the tables and generated sentences: PARENT.

answer_4.quote: We sample 500 instances from the ToTTo validation set ... we ask the annotators to evaluate the sentence on three questions as described in Section 3.2: Reasoning, Faithful and Coverage ... We prepared detailed annotation instructions, qualifying questions and trained a pool of 14 crowdsource annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer three questions: 1) Reasoning: Does the generated summary use all reasoning categories required? 2) Faithful: Is the generated summary hallucination free? 3) Coverage: Are all highlighted cells used?
